headline: Rodez v Montpellier: Montpellier favoured, margin view unmoved
summary: Montpellier are the market favourite at 39.5% fair to win, against Rodez at 33.2% and the draw at 27.3%. The sharp market cut the draw from 30.8% to 27.3%, but the consensus draw moved only 1.0 point, from 28.1% to 27.2%, so the sharp price moved into line with the rest of the market rather than ahead of it. Over 3.0 sits at 48.1% with a fair total of 2.93, inside the noise band; both teams to score is 63.0%.
